name: Google
short: Gemini/Gemma via Google AI Studio with a free tier; pay-as-you-go from $0.10/$0.40 per 1M, Vertex AI enterprise lane, and Antigravity IDE from $0/$30 per seat.

plans.name: AI Studio free tier
plans.notes: Free tier on selected Gemini Flash / Flash-Lite / Pro models.

plans.name: Gemini API pay-as-you-go
plans.price: from $0.10/$0.40 per 1M (Gemini 2.0 Flash, historical) up to $2.50/$15.00 per 1M (Gemini 2.5 Pro, prompts >200K)

plans.name: Antigravity Individual
plans.notes: Unlimited Tab completions and Command requests with a choice of agent models; basic weekly rate limits. Google AI Pro / Ultra raise the limits.

plans.name: Antigravity Business
plans.notes: Via Gemini Enterprise Standard/Plus; a pay-as-you-go plan has a $0 seat fee plus consumption-based pricing.
